theme: cross-sectional crypto spot momentum / reversal / volume / volatility, Binance spot daily klines (free), 2019-2026
data: research/data/xspot_cache/spot_daily.npz (677 USDT pairs incl. delisted, 2017-08..2026-08); no network, no orders, no money

construction.universe: top-50 by trailing-30d mean quote volume, >=$1M ADV, stables/wrapped excluded
construction.book: long top-10 / short bottom-10, equal weight, dollar-neutral, unit gross
construction.signal_lag: information through the CLOSE of day d-1
construction.execution: entered at the VWAP of day d (=quote_vol/base_vol), marked to the VWAP of day d+1

bounce_gate.finding: rho1 is a SPREAD diagnostic, not a cross-sectional-returns diagnostic: the microstructure term scales as 1/vol and single-coin daily vol (~5%) is ~100x a stablecoin spread's, so bounce cannot dominate. The theme-specific artefact is the MIRROR image: VWAP is a time-AVERAGED price, whose returns carry rho1 = +0.19 (theory +0.25) and manufacture fake MOMENTUM. Both artefacts are killed by the harness's one-day gap.

size_matched_placebo_slot_permutation.method: permute the signal across the day's ADV-rank slots, one permutation per replicate; turnover, universe, neutrality and cross-sectional return covariance all exactly preserved

rotate_returns_placebo_REJECTED.method: hold weights fixed, rotate the return panel circularly
rotate_returns_placebo_REJECTED.why_rejected: coins not yet listed at the rotated date have no return, so a dollar-neutral book silently acquires a 12.8% net directional leg (real book: 0.36%); the null grows a fat right tail (p95 5.74 on a per-formula SD of 0.53) and is not size-matched

the_wall.unpriced_input: Binance cross-margin borrow RATE and AVAILABILITY for small high-volatility alts is not in any free daily feed. It is the price of this trade and this round cannot measure it. Lesson 7 applies: free data prices a statistic, not a claim.

originality_disclosure: S1_VOL30 is the crypto low-volatility / lottery (MAX) anomaly. It is a PUBLISHED effect, not an invention. The theme brief asked for exactly this ranking, so it was tested; it is recorded as a found factor, not as an original strategy. The programme's own D0821 round contains two unfollowed hints of it (D4_XS_AMIHUD holdout +1.39 t 2.64; C4_XS_BAB holdout +0.79) that were rejected on their design windows.
holdout_reuse_disclosure: 2023-01..2026-08 has now been read by D0821 crypto-spot (34 formulas), rounds 2/3 on perps, and this round. The design-window result (gross 2.02-2.14, clean-placebo p<1/400) stands on its own and was frozen before the holdout was opened; the holdout number is a third look at that calendar.
